name: Fire Manager
description: Controls the behavior of fire balls in the game.
InternalName: ファイア(マネージャー)

fields.name: Stop Variable
fields.description: The variable that stops the fire balls.

fields.name: Fire Behavior
fields.description: Defines the movement pattern of the fire.

0.name: Alternating Left/Right
0.description: The fire alternates between left and right.

1.name: Always Centered
1.description: The fire stays centered at all times.

fields.name: Disappears After Activation
fields.description: Determines whether the fire disappears after activating the variable.

fields.name: Random Delay
fields.description: A random delay before the next flame appears.

fields.name: Delay
fields.description: A fixed delay before the next flame appears.

fields.name: Direction
fields.description: The direction the flame will travel.

0.name: South
0.description: The flame travels to the South.

1.name: North
1.description: The flame travels to the North.

2.name: East
2.description: The flame travels to the East.

3.name: West
3.description: The flame travels to the West.

fields.name: Flame Speed
fields.description: The speed at which the flame travels.

8.name: Faster Flying (Hits Only Enemies)
8.description: The flame travels faster and hits only enemies.
